description: This file defines a ChatLog component for a terminal UI, managing chat message components including user messages, assistant messages, tool executions, system messages, and inline messages. It provides methods to add, update, and remove various message types, handle pending user messages, and manage visual states within a chat interface.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A terminal UI component that manages a scrollable chat log, including user messages, assistant responses, tool executions, system messages, and inline messages. It supports operations like adding, updating, clearing, and reconciling pending users, as well as managing tool states and message visibility.

methods.name: dropComponentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a given component from internal maps and state.

methods.name: pruneOverflow
methods.description: Ensures the number of child components does not exceed the maximum, removing oldest components as needed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a component as a child and prunes overflow if necessary.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, tools, and optional pending users, resetting the chat log state.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Re-adds pending user message components that are not yet displayed.

methods.name: clearPendingUsers
methods.description: Removes all pending user message components from the chat log.

methods.name: createSystemMessage
methods.description: Creates a system message component with styled text.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message that can be updated before finalization.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as completed.

methods.name: dropPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message by runId.

methods.name: hasPendingUser
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending user message for a given runId.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages with given message history to finalize or discard pending entries.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of pending user messages.

methods.name: resolveRunId
methods.description: Resolves a runId to a default or provided value.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts a new assistant message stream or updates existing for a given runId.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates the text of an ongoing assistant message stream.

methods.name: finalizeAssistant
methods.description: Finalizes an assistant message, replacing the ongoing stream with a completed message.

methods.name: dropAssistant
methods.description: Removes an ongoing assistant message stream.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays an inline message (BtwInlineMessage) with question and answer, optionally as an error.

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Removes the inline message from the chat log.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if an inline message is currently visible.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts or updates a tool execution component based on a call ID.

methods.name: updateToolArgs
methods.description: Updates the arguments for an existing tool execution.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool execution, with optional error or partial result flags.

methods.name: setToolsExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses all tool components.
